summary: The BytePlus AI Startups Accelerator (V-Start) offers up to $100,000 USD in cloud coupons plus a voice/LLM credit package: $6.5K in voice AI model credits and 10B+ tokens in LLM credits, $137K+ in cloud resource subsidies, and 5+ AI-powered workshops. Open to startups in round D and before (<= Series D) with technical innovation in AI, enterprise services, e-commerce, mass consumption, Web3, VR/AR, etc. Approval is discretionary after application review.
claim_steps: Apply via the form at https://www.byteplus.com/en/contact-us/vstart with company and funding-round details.
Eligibility: startups in round D or earlier, in a focus sector (AI, enterprise services, e-commerce, Web3, VR/AR...).
Benefits are granted on approval: up to $100K cloud coupons, $6.5K voice AI credits, 10B+ LLM tokens, $137K+ resource subsidies.
